messageValues.message:
=You are an AI lead qualification agent. Score leads on a scale of 1-10 based on ICP fit.

Scoring Guide:
- 9-10: Perfect ICP match - exact title, industry, company size
- 7-8: Strong match - most criteria met
- 5-6: Moderate match - some criteria met
- 3-4: Weak match - few criteria met
- 1-2: Poor match - doesn't fit ICP

Return ONLY a valid JSON object (no markdown, no bullets, no extra text)

 with exactly these keys:

{
  "score": <integer 1-10>,
  "status": "Qualified" | "Unqualified",
  "reason": "<1-2 sentences>",
  "recommended_action": "Prioritize" | "Follow-up" | "Nurture" | "Archive"
}

status must be "Qualified" if score >= {{ $json.config.minScore }}, else "Unqualified".

Be concise and focus on business relevance.

## 🔄 Follow-up Flow

Sends follow-ups to leads who haven't replied.

- Runs daily at 10 AM (1 hour after initial)
- Max 3 follow-ups per lead
- 3 days between each follow-up
- Max 10 follow-ups/day
- Auto-marks "Max Follow-ups Reached" after 3

## 📋 Required Sheet Columns

Add these columns to your Leads sheet:

**Outreach Tracking:**
- Email Sent (TRUE/FALSE)
- Email Sent Date
- Email Subject
- Email Body
- Outreach Status

**Follow-up Tracking:**
- Follow-up Date
- Follow-up Count
- Last Follow-up Date
- Last Follow-up Subject
- Last Follow-up Body

**Outreach Status Values:**
- (empty) = Not contacted
- Sent - Awaiting Reply
- Max Follow-ups Reached
- Replied
- Bounced
- Unsubscribed


#### Prequisite :
You can only sign in Lusha using a business email so it should be "yourname@company.com"

It will not take in  "@Gmail.com" emails.

Update 'YOUR VALUE PROPOSITION' in the prompt

## 🎯 AI-Powered Lead Generation & Outreach (Lusha + AI Scoring + Auto Follow-ups) 
---
#### What this is: An end-to-end lead gen system. You define your Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) in a simple form, and the workflow finds matching contacts on Lusha, scores each one with AI against your ICP, saves qualified leads to a Google Sheet, then automatically drafts (or sends) personalized cold emails with AI-written follow-ups for anyone who doesn't reply.
#### Who it's for: Sales/growth teams, agencies, or founders doing outbound prospecting who want to skip manual list-building and personalize outreach at scale without writing every email by hand.

---
### How it works
1. **Fill the ICP form** — industry, seniority, location, company size, and a free-text description of your ideal customer.
2. **ICP Interpreter** (Code node) converts your form picks into Lusha's API filter format.
3. **Lusha Contact Search → Enrich** finds matching contacts and pulls full details (one enrich call handles up to 100 contacts — no looping needed).
4. **AI Lead Scoring** rates each contact 1–10 against your ICP and marks them Qualified/Unqualified with a reason.
5. Qualified leads are appended to a **Google Sheet**.
6. A **daily 9 AM** schedule picks up unsent qualified leads, has AI write a personalized cold email for each, and creates a Gmail **draft** (up to 20/day, 45s apart).
7. A **daily 10 AM** schedule checks for leads awaiting reply, and sends up to 3 AI-written follow-ups per lead (3 days apart, 10/day max) until they reply or hit the cap.
8. You can checkout the IDs for the HTTP request in the google sheets last sheet.
---

### Setup checklist
- [ ] **Lusha API key** — Header Auth credential, header name `api_key`. Get it from Lusha's API Hub (Admin/Manager on a Premium or Scale plan). ⚠️ You must sign up to Lusha with a **business email** (no @gmail.com) or the account won't work.
- [ ] **Google Sheets OAuth2** — connect your own account, then create a Sheet with the columns listed below.
- [ ] **Gmail OAuth2** — connect the inbox you want outreach to send from.
- [ ] **An LLM credential** for the AI nodes (this template uses Claude via OpenRouter — swap for any chat model you prefer).
- [ ] Update the credential IDs on both `Lusha: Contact Search` and `Lusha: Contact Enrich` nodes to point at your own Lusha credential.
- [ ] Replace `YOUR VALUE PROPOSITION` in the two email-writing prompts with your own pitch.
- [ ] **This template drafts emails by default — it doesn't auto-send.** Swap the Gmail "Create Draft" nodes for "Send Email" once you've tested it and are ready to go live.

### Required Google Sheet columns
`Contact ID, Full Name, Email, Phone, Job Title, Department, Seniority, LinkedIn URL, Company Name, Company Industry, Company Size, Company Website, Company Description, Company LinkedIn, Lead Score, Lead Status, Score Reason, Recommended Action, Created At, Email Sent, Email Sent Date, Email Subject, Email Body, Outreach Status, Follow-up Date, Follow-up Count, Last Follow-up Date, Last Follow-up Subject, Last Follow-up Body`
